caption: The drawing features a single object rendered in fine, black contour lines centered on a textured, off-white or light beige background with various small brown specks. Below this flap, multiple similarly shaped sections are stacked and angled alternately, creating a pattern with visible hinges or joints at the sides. There are no additional objects or background details besides the primary accordion-folded structure and the speckled, slightly stained appearance of the paper.
